Metadata.Goal: 把 organization-adjustment 接入生产 DomainContext API，并在现有 Workbench 中以唯一 JSON request authority 提供天级时间轴查看、编辑和执行闭环。
Metadata.Description: 先修复 server timeline DTO projection，再注册第三个 reference bundle，随后实现 as-of/effective-on/range JSON-derived controls，并以 HTTP 和 desktop/mobile Playwright 收敛。

TaskSpace.name: add-organization-timeline-workbench
TaskSpace.Description: 以 server timeline projection 为前置，串行推进 production registration、JSON-derived controls 和真实浏览器闭环。

TaskGroup.name: Timeline Projection And Production Registration
TaskGroup.Description: 先以 RED tests 证明 server 丢失 timeline，再补齐显式 projection、第三个 reference bundle 和完整 HTTP preset/freshness 证据。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: operation timeline capabilities 与 preset request timeline 经 GET projection 后保持 exact parse/catalog parity
production composition 稳定列出三个 reference contexts，createApp 默认仍为空
所有 organization presets 通过 HTTP 与 direct runtime 返回等价 stable facts

Task.name: Write timeline projection registration and HTTP RED tests
Task.Description: 扩展 bundle catalog 与 server integration tests，先验红 timeline capability/request 丢失、第三 bundle 未注册、组织 preset HTTP parity 和 fresh isolation。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: RED test 证明现有 GET catalog 丢失 definition.timeline 与 preset.request.timeline
RED test 要求 reference ids/map/registrations 三者按同序包含 organization-adjustment
RED test 覆盖每个组织 preset 的 parse/catalog/POST parity 与代表性 fresh calls

Task.name: Implement explicit timeline projection and production composition
Task.Description: 新增 closed timeline projection helpers，显式 clone definition/request facts；将组织 bundle 加入三份 reference authority，并保持 startup/injection/import boundaries。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: as-of/effective-on/range 与 optional recordedAt 均通过 server projection 精确保留
三个 reference exports、production startup 和 empty createApp 行为一致
server/bundle tests、typecheck/build、import guards 与旧 routes 全绿

TaskGroup.name: JSON-Derived Timeline Controls
TaskGroup.Description: 以 pure request edit API 实现三种 day mode 控件，确保无第二 request state 且 invalid editor 不被修复。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: 控件值只从 current valid editor request 派生，编辑只替换同一 JSON text
as-of/effective-on/range mode-specific fields 与日历/range validation 均可判定
invalid JSON/schema/catalog 保持原文且 timeline controls/execute unavailable

Task.name: Write timeline request editor RED tests
Task.Description: 为 pure update API 和页面派生行为覆盖三种 mode、字段错配、invalid date/range、catalog mismatch、immutable source 与 exact editor serialization。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: unit tests 覆盖四个 day fields 与三种 timeline mode
invalid editor/field edit 返回 diagnostics 且原 text/preset/catalog 不变
success edit 仅改变 request.timeline 目标字段并保持完整 request

Task.name: Implement pure editor update and responsive timeline strip
Task.Description: 在 domainWorkbenchRequest 实现 immutable timeline edit；DomainWorkbench 以 computed projection 渲染 mode-specific date inputs 和 recordedAt fact，不引入 date refs。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 页面无 timeline/date mutable ref，controls 由 parsedRequest.timeline computed 派生
date input edit 更新 requestJsonEditor 后立即复用 existing validator
timeline strip 在 desktop/mobile 稳定布局且 invalid state 无交互控件

TaskGroup.name: Browser Workflow And Convergence
TaskGroup.Description: 通过真实 production servers 捕获 exact body，执行组织 snapshot/apply/failure/partial，检查响应视图、响应式布局和全量边界。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Playwright 证明 date control 编辑值等于 editor JSON 且 POST body 完全相同
snapshot/apply/failure/partial 的 standard response views 均可检查
desktop/mobile、console/network、existing Kon IDE、build/boundary、fresh AttractorCheck 与 independent verify 全 PASS

Task.name: Implement temporal organization browser scenarios
Task.Description: 扩展 E2E：第三 context、三种 mode controls、edited snapshot body/outcome、apply success、atomic failure、partial mapping、invalid editor preservation 和 viewport geometry。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: network capture 对 edited editor text 做 JSON 深相等且 response 使用编辑后日期
标准 tabs 展示组织 tree、changes/probes/plan、failure diagnostics 与 partial item keys
desktop/mobile 控件在 viewport 内无 overlap/overflow，console errors 为零

Task.name: Run full integration boundary and track convergence
Task.Description: 运行 server/UI/bundle tests、Playwright、workspace build、import/capsule guards、Codument/XNL/XML/diff、final fresh AttractorCheck 和 independent verify，修复 completion-critical gaps。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 受影响 package tests、Playwright 与 full build 零失败
无 hidden request model、private import、server-to-bundle inversion 或 checked-in runtime DB
fresh AttractorCheck 和 independent verify 均 PASS，track evidence 可归档
